coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
GitLab

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Cloud Hosting FP&A role asks for someone who can turn detailed data into forecasts that engineering and finance leaders trust. That was the problem at Calder Industrial Components, where the forecast for our larger business unit was missing the mark. I rebuilt the model around order backlog and lifted accuracy from 88% to 96%.

As Financial Analyst, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD. I also cut month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, so the accruals, reconciliations and close commentary you describe are familiar work. I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data for plant managers, which means translating detailed numbers into clear recommendations for non-finance stakeholders. I haven't worked with cloud or AI vendor spend, but the skill is the same: investigating variances, finding the driver behind them and helping a business partner decide. At Redfern Stores, that approach uncovered a supplier rebate worth about 120,000 USD a year that nobody was claiming.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I could support your forecasting and annual planning cycles. I'm available to talk at your convenience and comfortable working independently in an asynchronous, remote setup.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
